svg.aria-label: mcp-doctor demo: a server that grades an A still has a bug that will break an agent, the release verdict blocks it, mcp-doctor --fix fixes it and the verdict becomes SHIP, then guard catches a live call that reported success without writing the file
svg.text: mcp-doctor · evals and guardrails for AI agents

g.text: It grades an A, and it still breaks agents

text.tspan: a client that sends the advertised null default
gets a validation error, and the tool never runs.

g.text: Every score is an A, and the release gate still says no

text.tspan: - static scan: will break an agent: get_forecast(units) (server.py:14): a client that
sends the advertised null default gets a validation error, and the tool never runs.

g.text: Fix it in place, and BLOCK becomes SHIP

text.tspan: (checked: null defaults, stdout on stdio, mcp 2.x start-up)
-def get_forecast(city: str, days: int, units: str = None) -> str:
+def get_forecast(city: str, days: int, units: str | None = None) -> str:

g.text: In production: catch a "success" that didn't happen

text.tspan: ⚠ mcp-doctor guard: write_file reported success, but reading it back with
get_file_info(path='/tmp/report.md') failed: "Error: ENOENT: no such file
or directory, stat '/tmp/report.md'". The write may not have happened.
The result still says success (isError: false); guard adds the warning the agent reads,
so it can retry or tell you instead of saying "done".

g.text: Find → Block → Fix → Guard, in one open-source CLI
Finds 15,755 of 15,977 tools across 805 real MCP servers, every miss published
Fixes merged by maintainers at Microsoft · AWS · NVIDIA · Intel · IBM · Cisco
